basics.name: Federico Failla
basics.label: Java Developer | Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software developer with more than 5 years of experience working mainly with Java in different sectors, including banking, taxes, gaming, and reservation/order management systems. In recent years I have contributed to online booking and work-order platforms, handling application implementation and deployment with GitLab, AZDO, Docker and Rancher. I have strong experience with Java 8–17 and Spring Boot, as well as knowledge of React and TypeScript for building modern user interfaces. I am characterized by teamwork, collaboration and a commitment to delivering efficient, high-quality solutions.

highlights: Tech stack: Java 17, Spring 3.4, Groovy Spock, React 18, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitLab, Azure DevOps.
